Marco Luthi

📌 [...] Hi everyone, I'm Marco. I make small iPhone apps on my own. Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. Clip the phone to a lanyard and turn it upside down: the badge turns round to face the people in front of you and swings a little as you walk. Slide it top first into a chest pocket and it shrinks to a strip, so your name shows above the edge. The pocket check uses the front camera for a few seconds while the phone is upside down. A small model on the phone decides, and the frames are never stored. You can keep several badges (work, a conference, a meetup), add a link that turns into a QR code on the back, and choose a design: Classic, Office, Event, Minimal or Live, which moves. It's free with one badge; Pro is a one-time purchase. I'd love to hear where you'd wear it, and what's [...] purchase. I'd love to hear where you'd wear it, and what's missing.
